hub.rationale: Sholinganallur is the only candidate that is central to the corridor geometry, the OMR rail line boundary and the GCC free-supply network. route_clusters.notes: Navalur is the ECR-north anchor: one gate-to-gate loop covers Kudimiyandi Thoppu MGR Nagar, Rajiv Gandhi Nagar, Annai Indiranagar, VGP Avenue, Santham Avenue and Akkarai without touching the OMR congestion band twice.

The OMR main run - Thazhuthendur, Kandanchal, Siruthai, Semmancheri, Poothapedi, Kovilambedu, Mappedu and Egumudi - is one long north-south corridor. It is the most stretched cluster in the zone because Mappedu sits 8 km inland from the OMR spine.

Sholinganallur town plus the OMR IT belt: ELCOT, the Infosys campus township, RMZ Ecoworld at Thandalam and Tidel Park on the Rajiv Gandhi IT Expressway. High case density, high price tolerance, long hops between the IT campuses.

Palavakkam and the Enjambakkam pocket on the East Coast Road, including the GCC Meenambakkam pet clinic and ABC centre at B V Nagar. Ten localities, so the loop is split in the model into a Palavakkam half and an Enjambakkam half sharing one vehicle day.
Perungudi town and the four residential pockets behind the OMR Salai commercial ribbon. Compact and densely built - the highest services-per-trip ratio in the zone.

Madipakkam OMR side: the main town, Karthikeyapuram, Lake View, Sendhuram Colony and Ayyappa Nagar. Strong apartment stock, 4 to 5 km west of the OMR spine, so access is via the internal network rather than the corridor.

Thiruvanmiyur as the southern anchor: town, T. Nagar, Indira Nagar, Sriram Nagar, Anchaneya Nagar and the VOC Street core. This cluster sits on the Zone A / Zone B seam and carries the zone's highest existing clinic density.

key_caveats: Census 2011 ward tables use the pre-2018 155-ward structure and cannot be mapped one to one onto GCC wards 181-200. Households for the new ward structure are therefore modelled from the GCC residential property-tax ledger (tier A) and Census-2011 Corporation population (tier A); they are tier B and carry a plus or minus 25 percent band.

Sub-locality coordinates for the OMR villages (Kandanchal, Thazhuthendur, Siruthai, Poothapedi, Kovilambedu, Egumudi) are tier B: positioned on the OSM-mapped Rajiv Gandhi Salai spine at the chainage implied by the brief's OMR sequence. They are accurate to roughly 700 m, which is adequate for route design but not for door-level service planning.

The brief's Zone B north limit reads 'Navalur and the Thazhuthendur side, up to but not including Padur and Kelambakkam'. Padur and Kelambakkam lie south-west of Navalur on OMR and Thazhuthendur lies north-east of it, so the stated north limit is internally inconsistent. The reading applied here is the one the anchor list forces: include Navalur, Kandanchal, Thazhuthendur, Siruthai, Semmancheri, Sholinganallur, Egumudi, Mappedu; exclude Padur, Kelambakkam and everything north of Navalur.

GCC's 'Meenambakkam' pet clinic and ABC centre is listed by the corporation at Div 166 Zone XII with the street address B V Nagar, Nanganallur 600061. That address is the Enjambakkam B V Nagar pocket inside Zone B. The Meenambakkam suburb 3 km further west is outside the zone and is excluded. The naming collision must be resolved before the centre is used as a distance anchor.

Thiruvanmiyur sits on the Zone A / Zone B seam. The Tidel Park and Rajiv Gandhi IT Expressway node and the Thiruvanmiyur cluster will pull to Zone A's north side. The southern 6 localities are modelled here in full but the verification of the seam is the single largest source of forecast error in this zone.
